description: A cyclone approaches the farmhouse and the family reacts.

beats.action: Warns Aunt Em that a cyclone is coming and runs toward the sheds to look after the stock.
beats.decisionBoundaryBefore: Uncle Henry chooses to protect the livestock after recognizing the approaching cyclone.
beats.resultingState: Uncle Henry is running toward the sheds; Aunt Em remains in the house; Dorothy holds Toto at the doorway.

beats.action: Drops her work, sees the danger, and orders Dorothy to run for the cellar.
beats.decisionBoundaryBefore: Aunt Em responds to the immediate danger by directing Dorothy to shelter.
beats.resultingState: Aunt Em has stopped washing dishes and has ordered Dorothy toward the cellar; Dorothy still holds Toto.

beats.action: Jumps from Dorothy's arms and hides under the bed.
beats.decisionBoundaryBefore: Toto reacts to the emergency by fleeing from Dorothy.
beats.resultingState: Toto is under the bed and Dorothy is no longer holding him.

beats.action: Starts trying to retrieve Toto from under the bed.
beats.decisionBoundaryBefore: Dorothy chooses to retrieve Toto rather than immediately descend to the cellar.
beats.resultingState: Dorothy has begun trying to get Toto; Toto remains under the bed; Aunt Em has not yet descended.

playerAction.boundaryReason: The retrieval attempt is interrupted by Aunt Em opening the trapdoor and descending.
playerAction.choiceText: Retrieve Toto from under the bed before taking shelter.
playerAction.completion: Dorothy begins reaching for Toto, but the source interrupts before she catches him.
interruptWhen: Aunt Em opens the trapdoor and descends.

beats.action: Throws open the trapdoor and climbs down the ladder into the cyclone cellar.
beats.decisionBoundaryBefore: Aunt Em commits to taking shelter in the cellar after seeing the danger.
beats.resultingState: The trapdoor is open; Aunt Em is descending into the cellar; Dorothy is still trying to retrieve Toto.

beats.action: Catches Toto and starts toward Aunt Em.
beats.decisionBoundaryBefore: Dorothy resumes the shelter goal after securing Toto.
beats.resultingState: Dorothy is holding Toto and is halfway across the room toward the open trapdoor; Aunt Em is in the cellar.

playerAction.boundaryReason: The house's violent shaking interrupts Dorothy halfway across the room.
playerAction.choiceText: Catch Toto and follow Aunt Em toward the cellar.
playerAction.completion: Dorothy catches Toto and begins following Aunt Em but has not reached the cellar.
preconditions: Toto is accessible under the bed.
The trapdoor is open and Aunt Em is in the cellar.
interruptWhen: The house shakes and Dorothy loses her footing.

beats.action: Loses her footing when the house shakes and sits down suddenly on the floor.
beats.resultingState: Dorothy is seated on the floor while holding Toto; she has not reached the cellar.

description: Dorothy and the Scarecrow discover and rescue the Tin Woodman.

beats.action: Wakes, leaves the cottage with the Scarecrow, and searches for water.
beats.decisionBoundaryBefore: Dorothy chooses to search for water for washing and drinking.
beats.resultingState: Dorothy, Toto, and the Scarecrow have left the cottage and are searching the forest for water.

beats.action: Finds a spring, drinks, bathes, and eats breakfast.
beats.resultingState: Dorothy has washed, drunk water, and eaten breakfast; little bread remains.

beats.action: Hears a groan and asks what caused it.
beats.decisionBoundaryBefore: Dorothy chooses to investigate the nearby groan.
beats.resultingState: Dorothy and the Scarecrow know that a groan is coming from nearby, but its source is not yet identified.

beats.action: Agrees that they should investigate the groan.
beats.resultingState: Dorothy and the Scarecrow have decided to search for the source of the groan.

beats.action: Discovers the Tin Woodman standing motionless beside a partly chopped tree with an axe raised.
beats.resultingState: Dorothy and the Scarecrow have found the Tin Woodman immobilized beside the tree.

beats.action: Barks at and snaps at the Tin Woodman's tin legs, hurting his teeth.
beats.resultingState: Toto has barked at the Tin Woodman and hurt his teeth; the Tin Woodman remains motionless.

beats.action: Explains that he has been groaning for more than a year because rust has immobilized him.
beats.resultingState: Dorothy knows the Tin Woodman has been trapped and unable to move for more than a year.

beats.action: Runs to the cottage, retrieves the oil-can, and returns to the Tin Woodman.
beats.decisionBoundaryBefore: Dorothy chooses to rescue the Tin Woodman by obtaining the oil-can.
beats.resultingState: Dorothy has the oil-can and is back beside the immobilized Tin Woodman.

beats.action: Oils the Tin Woodman's neck while the Scarecrow moves his head until the joint works freely.
beats.decisionBoundaryBefore: Dorothy begins freeing the Tin Woodman's rusted joints, starting with his neck.
beats.resultingState: The Tin Woodman's neck joint is free, and he can turn his head himself; his arms and legs remain rusted.

beats.action: Oils the Tin Woodman's arm joints while the Scarecrow bends them until they are free.
beats.resultingState: The Tin Woodman's neck and arm joints are free; his leg joints remain rusted.

beats.action: Lowers his axe and leans it against the tree after his arms are freed.
beats.resultingState: The Tin Woodman is no longer holding the raised axe; it rests against the tree while his legs remain rusted.

beats.action: Oils the Tin Woodman's leg joints until he can move freely.
beats.decisionBoundaryBefore: Dorothy completes the rescue by freeing the Tin Woodman's legs.
beats.resultingState: The Tin Woodman can move all of his joints and has been freed from his year-long immobilization.
